assets.title: Imagem documental para a curiosidade 04-italia-curiosity-05
assets.alt: Night photograph of the Temple of Segesta, an ancient Greek temple in Sicily, Italy. The image was taken from approximately 250 meters away with a 10‑second exposure using a Canon 80D and a 50 mm lens. The photograph shows the temple within its surrounding landscape, highlighting the texture of the stone and the ambient nighttime atmosphere. The Temple of Segesta is one of the best‑preserved ancient Greek temples in Sicily.

assets.alt: Juggling on the Berlin Wall on 16. November 1989. The black, white and red graffitti banner on the wall below the juggler depicts a pair of marching hammers, an allusion to the film Pink Floyd The Wall. The text sprayed over the banner reads "Der Kampf gegen [d]ie Mauer geht [weiter.]" (German), which means "the fight against the wall continues".
